## For people who don't want to read the full description
Simply optimised is basically a performance modpack, best suited for new players who dont want the hassel of creating their very own modpack. This is a fork of the original modpack by hsza. Original modpack: https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop

# Super Optimised — Performance & Simplicity for New Players

## Overview
**Super Optimised** is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack designed specifically for players new to the modding scene. Built as a fork of the original [Simply Optimised Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) by hsza, this version maintains the core philosophy of delivering smooth, lag-free gameplay without overwhelming complexity or configuration requirements.

Whether you're playing on an older laptop, a budget PC, or just want a noticeably smoother vanilla experience, Super Optimised gets you there in minutes—not hours.

---

## What Makes Super Optimised Special?

### 🚀 Performance First
Super Optimised strips away unnecessary bloat and focuses on what matters: **FPS and stability**. Every mod included has been carefully selected to enhance performance rather than hinder it. Expect:
- Significantly improved frame rates, even on lower-end hardware
- Reduced lag and stuttering during gameplay
- Faster world loading times
- Optimized chunk rendering and memory usage
- Smooth multiplayer performance

### 👶 Beginner-Friendly
No complex configurations. No confusing settings. Super Optimised works right out of the box:
- **Zero setup required** — download, install, and play
- Pre-configured settings optimized for most systems
- Clear, helpful loading screens and documentation
- No decision fatigue — all the best mods are already chosen for you
- Perfect entry point into modded Minecraft

### 🎯 Lastest Multi-Version Support [Maintained]
Super Optimised is available across multiple Minecraft versions, so you can enjoy smooth performance whether you're playing the latest updates or sticking with your favorite legacy version.

---

## What's Included?

Super Optimised bundles essential performance-enhancing mods such as:
- **Rendering optimizations** — for dramatically better FPS
- **Memory management improvements** — to prevent crashes and stuttering
- **Loading speed enhancements** — get in-game faster
- **Compatibility patches** — ensuring everything works together seamlessly

All mods are handpicked to maintain a **vanilla-like experience** while eliminating performance bottlenecks. You get the pure Minecraft feel with the benefits of optimization.

---

## Who Should Use Super Optimised?

✅ **New to modding?** This is your starting point.  
✅ **Playing on older hardware?** This modpack was made for you.  
✅ **Want better FPS without learning mod configs?** Look no further.  
✅ **Solo player or multiplayer server enthusiast?** Works great for both.  

Super Optimised is perfect if you love Minecraft but want it to run smoother without sacrificing the core experience.

---

## Quick Start

1. **Download** the modpack for your preferred Minecraft version
2. **Install** using your favorite launcher (CurseForge, Modrinth, MultiMC, etc.)
3. **Play** — no additional configuration needed
4. **Enjoy** significantly improved performance

That's it. No tinkering required.

---

## System Requirements

Simply Optimised is designed to run well on a variety of systems:
- **Minimum:** 2GB RAM allocated to Minecraft, any reasonably modern CPU
- **Recommended:** 4GB+ RAM, 4+ core processor for optimal experience
- **GPU:** Integrated graphics supported; dedicated GPU recommended for higher render distances

Even on minimum specs, you'll see noticeable performance improvements over vanilla Minecraft.

---

## Credits & Attribution

Simply Optimised is a community-driven fork building upon the excellent work of **hsza** and the original [Simply Optimised Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop). We're grateful for the foundation and continue to maintain and improve upon it for new generations of players.

---

## Support & Community

Experiencing issues? Have suggestions? The Simply Optimised community is here to help:
- Report bugs and request features on our github repository

---

## Final Thoughts

Simply Optimised proves that you don't need hundreds of mods, complicated configs, or hours of setup to dramatically improve your Minecraft experience. Sometimes, simple is better—especially when "simple" means **playable FPS and zero headaches**.

**Ready to experience Minecraft the way it should run?** Download Simply Optimised today and join thousands of players enjoying lag-free, beautifully optimized gameplay.

---

*Simply Optimised: Performance without the hassle.*
